subject: Access gates for Redwood onboarding - SSO/SCIM/Service accounts
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@atratotech.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@atratotech.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access gates for Redwood onboarding - SSO/SCIM/Service accounts

Hi Markus / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at AtratoTech is excited to move forward. Before the technical kickoff we need to confirm a few enterprise access controls so our security and networking teams can sign off. High level asks: 

- SSO/SAML: what metadata do you need from us and is there anything special for persistent session durations?
- SCIM provisioning: which attributes do you provision, and do you support scoped service accounts for groups?
- IP allowlist: please confirm the egress IP ranges we should whitelist on our firewall. I attached our Prod egress list (atrato_prod_ips.csv).
- Service accounts & org policy: we need recommended least-privilege roles for RW service accounts and any org-level policies we should prepare.

Can you point us to a short checklist or template we can start filling? Also propose 30–45m for a kickoff next week (preferably Tue/Wed).

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Platforms
AtratoTech

Attachments: atrato_prod_ips.csv (CSV, 1.2KB)

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@atratotech.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@atratotech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access gates for Redwood onboarding - SSO/SCIM/Service accounts

Elena — great to hear, and thanks for the clear list. Putting a concise tech checklist below and attaching the config templates so your engineering team can drop values in.

Short answers up front:
- SAML: we accept IdP metadata XML or the individual fields (entityID, SSO URL, x509 cert). Session length is configurable per-tenant; default is 8 hours, can be shortened to meet your policy.
- SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0. Typical attributes we sync: userName, givenName, familyName, email, active, groups (group membership). We support scoped SCIM tokens and can provision group-scoped service accounts — see section "Scoped provisioning" in the attached guide.
- IP allowlist: Redwood hosted egress is a small set of static IPv4 ranges; please whitelist the list we attached. For Dedicated / Private deployments we can provide private peering details.
- Service accounts/org policies: recommend two service accounts — one for provisioning (scoped to write users/groups) and one for runtime (read-only tokens for telemetry). See the mutual action plan for recommended RBAC.

Attachments included: saml_config_template.xml, scim_provisioning_quickstart.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Atrato: fill saml_template + scim attribute map (by Tue 13 Apr)
2) Redwood: review configs and prepare test IdP (by Thu 15 Apr)
3) Joint: 45m tech kickoff + test SAML assertion exchange (Mon/Wed 19–21 Apr)

If that timeline works, Marissa will send a calendar invite and I can loop in engineering if we need deeper SSO troubleshooting.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: saml_config_template.xml (XML, 2.1KB); scim_provisioning_quickstart.pdf (PDF, 220KB); mutual_action_plan.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)

Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access gates for Redwood onboarding - SSO/SCIM/Service accounts

Elena — looping in in case you want procurement/contract alignment ahead of the kickoff. A couple quick notes:

- For AtratoTech's scale, the standard Dedicated onboarding SLA applies; if you prefer a dedicated pool we can include that in the mutual action plan and provide pricing.
- I'll create the DocuSign envelope for the MSA + Data Addendum and tag the sections related to security controls (SAML, SCIM, IP allowlist).

Proposed call for contracting: Tue 13 Apr 09:00 PT. If that conflicts with your engineered timeline, tell us a preferred slot and we'll adapt.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access gates for Redwood onboarding - SSO/SCIM/Service accounts

Thanks all — schedule and checklist confirmed.

Elena / Amit — I created a short tech kickoff agenda and a shared drive folder (link below) for the artifacts you requested. Agenda highlights:
- 10m introductions + roles (security, networking, SRE)
- 20m SAML metadata exchange + live assertion test
- 10m SCIM attribute map review and provisioning test plan
- 5m IP allowlist verification and firewall notes
- 5m next steps / action owners

Links & artifacts:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/401-ATR-45
- Drive folder (config drop): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRDW-ATR-45
- DocuSign MSA envelope: https://www.docusign.com/Signing/?s=RDW-ATR-0045

I've attached the same templates Mark provided and added a short service-account role matrix (see mutual_action_plan.xlsx). Please add your completed saml_config_template.xml to the Drive folder before the kickoff.

Proposed kickoff: Wed 21 Apr 2027 10:00 AM PT — I will send the calendar invite when you confirm.

Quick ask for Atrato security team: if you require a SOC2 evidence package or specific audit logs retention details before contract signing, flag which documents you need and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
